text: Overdosage: Nausea, vomiting, epigastric pain, hepatotoxic and nephrotoxic action, in severe cases - hepatic insufficiency, hepatic necrosis, increase in "liver" transaminase activity, increase in prothrombin time, encephalopathy, and comatose state. Treatment: gastric lavage, administration of activated charcoal, symptomatic therapy. Administration of methionine 8-9 hours after the overdosage and N-acetylcysteine - after 12 hours. Medical attention should be sought.
